tools.description: Replace one exact span of text inside the assistant's messages or your own, leaving the rest of it untouched. oldText must appear exactly once in that message; copy it verbatim from a message_search preview or from the message you sent. This is the tool for every correction to something you already posted — when the user points out a mistake, fix that message instead of posting a correction as a new one. It runs immediately without asking the user to confirm, because it can only change text you quoted. If oldText does not match, the call fails without changing anything and returns the message as it currently reads, so retry with a span copied from that. urls.description: List of fully-qualified public URLs to fetch, e.g. ["https://example.com/article"]. Maximum 10 URLs per call. Localhost and private IPs are blocked.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the image to generate. Write it like describing a scene to an artist, not a keyword list.

tools.description: List registered company documents newest first, with their numbers, counterparts, file paths, and summaries. Filter by type, counterpart, or keyword. Use to answer 'what quotes did we send to X'.

counterpart.description: Counterpart name to filter by, e.g. 'ABC물산'.

query.description: Keyword filter matched against title, summary, and counterpart.

type.description: Document type slug to filter by, e.g. 'quote'. Leave empty for all types.

tools.name: company_document_list

tools.description: Register a company document in the document ledger and, for kind=issued, receive the official document number to print in the document plus the storage directory to save the final file in. Call BEFORE rendering an official document so the number appears in it. Always include a 2-3 sentence summary of the document's key terms (parties, amounts, dates) so later questions can be answered without re-reading the file.

counterpart.description: Counterpart company or person name, e.g. 'ABC물산'.

documentType.description: Document type slug from the paperwork catalog, e.g. 'quote', 'service-agreement', 'employment-certificate'.

filePath.description: Workspace path of the file if it already exists. For issued documents you can also set it later with company_document_update after saving.

kind.description: 'issued' for documents the company creates (default, gets a document number), 'received' for documents from counterparts, 'internal' for internal-only files.

summary.description: 2-3 sentence summary of the document's key terms: parties, amounts, dates, obligations. Written so later questions can be answered without opening the file.

title.description: Document title including the counterpart, e.g. 'ABC물산 김인턴 도입 컨설팅 견적서'.

tools.name: company_document_register

tools.description: Semantically search registered company documents by a natural-language question ('ABC와 맺은 계약 조건'). Returns best-matching documents with summaries — answer from the summary first and open the file only when detail is needed.

limit.description: Maximum documents to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: Natural-language question or topic, e.g. 'ABC물산이랑 맺은 용역 계약 대금 조건'.

tools.name: company_document_search

tools.description: Update a registered document's file path, title, counterpart, or summary by id from a prior list/search result. Use when a file was moved or renamed so the ledger keeps tracking it.

counterpart.description: Corrected counterpart. Omit to keep unchanged.

filePath.description: New workspace path after the file was saved, moved, or renamed.

id.description: Document id from a prior company_document_list or search result.

summary.description: Replacement summary. Omit to keep unchanged.

title.description: Corrected title. Omit to keep unchanged.

tools.name: company_document_update

tools.description: Read the company master profile (name, representative, address, contact, bank account, country-specific legal attributes such as 사업자등록번호). Pass language ('ko' or 'en') to get the view for that document language plus missingFields listing empty core fields. Call this before creating any company letterhead document; if missingFields is empty, never ask the user for company info again.

language.description: Document language to resolve the profile for, e.g. 'ko' or 'en'. Defaults to 'ko'. The response's missingFields lists core fields still empty for this language.

tools.name: company_info_get

tools.description: Save or update the company master profile. Partial update: only provided fields are written, into the given language's slot for localized fields. Use after the user supplies company details, or when they report a change ('회사 주소 바뀌었어'). Put country-specific identifiers (사업자등록번호, 법인등록번호, 업태, 종목, EIN …) into legalAttributes as a label-to-value JSON object string.

bankAccount.description: One-line bank account: bank, account number, holder. Use the 'en' slot for international wire details (SWIFT/IBAN).

brandName.description: Service or brand name when it differs from the legal name.

description.description: One-line company description for proposals and IR material.

employeeCount.description: Official employee headcount. Independent of platform member count.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction of incorporation for contract preambles, e.g. '대한민국' or 'the State of Delaware'.

language.description: Language slot the localized values belong to, e.g. 'ko' or 'en'.

legalAttributes.description: JSON object string of country-specific label-to-value pairs, e.g. {"사업자등록번호": "123-45-67890", "업태": "서비스"}. Labels print on documents as-is.

officeAddress.description: Working office address when it differs from the registered address.

representative.description: Representative's name; use the romanized name for the 'en' slot.

representativeTitle.description: Representative's title. Defaults to 대표이사 (ko) / CEO (en).

slogan.description: Company slogan for letterheads and introductions.

tools.name: company_info_set

tools.description: List recorded company metrics sorted by period. Filter by metric key and year range. Use for IR decks, business plans, and grant applications that need revenue/headcount/usage time series.

metric.description: Metric key to filter by, e.g. 'annualRevenue'. Leave empty for all metrics.

tools.name: company_metric_list

tools.description: Record or correct one company metric value for a period — annual revenue, operating profit, MAU, employee count, GMV and similar time-series numbers. Monetary values use an allowed currency plus a stable USD equivalent; non-monetary values use unit. Add quarter (1-4) OR month (1-12) for sub-annual periods, never both. Same call overwrites the same period.

currency.description: ISO currency of a monetary value. Use currency instead of unit for money.

metric.description: Metric key in lowerCamelCase, e.g. 'annualRevenue', 'operatingProfit', 'mau', 'employees'. Reuse the same key across periods.

month.description: Month 1-12 for a monthly value. Leave out for annual or quarterly values; never combine with quarter.

note.description: Source or context note, e.g. '재무제표 기준'.

quarter.description: Quarter 1-4 for a quarterly value. Leave out for annual or monthly values; never combine with month.

unit.description: Unit for a non-monetary value, e.g. '명', '건', 'sites'. Do not combine with currency.

value.description: Numeric value, e.g. 1200000000 for 12억 원. Use the raw number, not a formatted string.

valueUSD.description: Stable USD equivalent for a non-USD monetary value. Required when currency is not USD; omitted for non-monetary values.

year.description: Four-digit year the value belongs to, e.g. 2025.

tools.name: company_metric_record

tools.description: Add one company history/asset record: milestones (연혁), funding rounds, products, patents, certifications, awards, client references, government grants. Set category, date, title; put structured details (amount, investors, round …) into attributes as a label-to-value JSON object string.

attributes.description: JSON object string of structured details, e.g. {"round": "Seed", "amount": "20억 원", "investors": "ABC벤처스"}.

category.description: Record category: 'history' (연혁), 'funding', 'product', 'certification', 'ip', 'award', 'reference', 'grant', or another short kebab-case label.

date.description: Date of the event in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM format. Used to sort the company timeline.

title.description: Short title, e.g. '시드 투자 유치' or '김인턴 정식 출시'.

tools.name: company_record_add

tools.description: Delete a company record by id from a prior company_record_list result. Use only when the user asks to remove a wrong entry.

id.description: Record id from a prior company_record_list result. Never invent an id.

tools.name: company_record_delete

tools.description: List company history/asset records, newest first. Filter by category (history, funding, product, certification, ip, award, reference, grant …) or keyword query. Use to build 연혁 sections, funding tables, and product overviews.

category.description: Category to filter by, e.g. 'funding' or 'history'. Leave empty for all.

query.description: Keyword filter matched against title, detail, and attributes.

tools.name: company_record_list

tools.description: Update fields on an existing company record identified by id from a prior company_record_list result. Only provided fields change.

attributes.description: JSON object string replacing the stored attributes. Omit to keep unchanged.

category.description: New category. Omit to keep unchanged.

date.description: New date. Omit to keep unchanged.

detail.description: New detail text. Omit to keep unchanged.

id.description: Record id from a prior company_record_list result.

title.description: New title. Omit to keep unchanged.

tools.name: company_record_update

flagged.description: Set to true to star/flag the message, false to remove the flag. Omit to leave the flagged state unchanged.

mailbox.description: IMAP mailbox folder of the message, e.g. 'INBOX'. Must come from a prior list or search result.

seen.description: Set to true to mark as read, false to mark as unread. Omit to leave the read state unchanged.

uid.description: IMAP UID of the message to mark. Must come from a prior list or search result — never invent a UID.

targetMailbox.description: Destination IMAP folder, e.g. 'Archive', 'Trash', 'Work/Projects'. The folder must already exist.

uid.description: IMAP UID of the message to move. Must come from a prior list or search result — never invent a UID.

tools.name: mail_message_move

tools.description: Fetch the full content of a single email by its mailbox name and UID. The UID must come from a prior mail_message_list or mail_message_search result — never invent a UID.

uid.description: IMAP UID of the message to read. Must come from a prior mail_message_list or mail_message_search result — never invent a UID.

tools.name: mail_message_read

tools.description: Search emails by keyword, sender, or subject. Returns matching messages with their UIDs for use with mail.message.read. Do not put pagination cursors in the query field.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous search response. Omit on the first call.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching messages to return. Defaults to 20.

mailbox.description: IMAP mailbox folder to search, e.g. 'INBOX'. Defaults to all folders when omitted.

query.description: Search terms matched against subject, sender, and body, e.g. 'invoice Q2 2026'. Required.

bcc.description: BCC recipient email addresses. Recipients cannot see each other.

body.description: Email body text. Plain text or HTML.

to.description: Primary recipient email addresses, e.g. ["alice@example.com"]. At least one required.
